FC_diagonal_handling: diagonal zeroed before arctanh so arctanh(1)=inf is never produced, then set to exactly 0.0
FC_Strength_exclusion_reason: FC_Strength == DC / 245 exactly; perfectly collinear with DC (Pearson r = 1.0), carries no independent information. Verified this acquisition: max|DC/245 - FC_Strength| = 0.000e+00. Raw fc_strength.npy/.csv left untouched.

normalization_methods.mALFF: ALFF_i / mean(ALFF) over this acquisition's own 246 ROIs (ratio, not z-score)
normalization_methods.mReHo: ReHo_i / mean(ReHo) over this acquisition's own 246 ROIs
normalization_methods.DC_z: (DC_i - mean(DC)) / std(DC, ddof=0) within this acquisition
normalization_methods.FC_fisher_z: arctanh(clip(r, -0.999999, 0.999999)) on off-diagonal only; diagonal exactly 0; signed, unthresholded, negatives retained; NOT z-scored within subject

cross_subject_note: none applied: this stage is within-subject only and therefore leakage-free. Cross-subject scaling must be fitted on training subjects only, after a subject-level split.
